requirements.text: Activities (actor, action, target, tenant, time) are recorded when the underlying change commits
Retried recording of the same event does not create duplicate entries
Viewers see only activities on objects they are currently allowed to see
The feed lists newest first with cursor pages that have no gaps or repeats
Similar consecutive activities are grouped (for example "Ana and 3 others commented")
Old entries are pruned according to a retention policy
Entry text is rendered as text and links are validated

evidence.name: a repeated dedupeKey returns the existing item
publish and list: newest first, opaque cursor pages without gaps or repeats
prune drops items past retention and the oldest beyond maxPerUser
publish validation: unsafe links, titles and data are rejected

implementations.notes: A per-recipient inbox: usable as a fan-out-on-write personal feed, but it does not check object permissions at read time or aggregate entries
